name: SWE/2 sonic rifle
description: The SWE/2 sonic rifle was a type of sonic rifle manufactured by Telex-Delcor as a follow-up to the initial SWE/1 design used during the Clone Wars. It could incapacitate even the toughest, most persistent malcontent, equipped with a powerful acoustic generator to fire a concentrated beam of sound waves that were similar in power and performance to particle-beam packets fired by other blasters. When used on sentient beings, it was capable of affecting a target's hearing and sense of balance, staggering them and shorting out their fine-motor centers.
